notes: New: your Strategy tab now checks whether your scheduled lump sums are placed as well as they could be. Keeping the same dates and the same total, it finds the split across your debts that saves the most interest - and tells you exactly how much you'd save before you change anything.
The Strategy Comparison now says plainly which strategy you're on, with your current months and interest right at the top, and marks your plan among the cards.

Fixed: the old Re-distribute button moved your lump sums onto the debts your strategy was already attacking, which could make your plan worse. Your monthly extra payment is already hitting those debts - a lump sum does more good where the monthly payment won't reach in time. The optimizer now handles this properly and will never recommend a change that costs you money.

Fixed: the Strategy Comparison could give contradictory advice, because it compared both strategies against one fixed lump sum allocation. Each strategy is now shown with your lump sums placed at their best for that strategy.
